requested.title: Password confirmation is not enforced by the server-side schema
deleteTodo reports success when no row was deleted

parsedVerdicts.reasoning: The original finding was valid, but the current `src/schemas/user-schemas.ts` contains an object-level refinement requiring `data.password === data.passwordConfirmation`. `src/server/handlers/user-handlers.ts` registers `updateUserSchema` with the server function's `.validator(...)`, so mismatched values are rejected before the handler can call `auth.api.changePassword`. This also rejects a non-empty password when confirmation is omitted, because `passwordConfirmation` defaults to an empty string and fails the equality check. Although the handler still ignores `passwordConfirmation`, doing so is safe for this contract after the validator establishes equality. The same server-enforceable refinement is now present on `signUpSchema`. `src/schemas/user-schemas.test.ts` explicitly verifies rejection of mismatched profile and signup passwords. The patch was introduced by commit `a041f94337e958247fb48f6d2ab0ed41cb6dc446` (`Harden session and profile data handling`), and the current HEAD retains it.

The original implementation had the reported truthiness bug because Drizzle's `.returning()` produces an array and an empty array is truthy. The current `src/server/services/todo-service.ts` instead destructures the result with `const [todo] = await ...returning()`. When the compound todo ID and user ID predicate matches no row, `todo` is therefore `undefined`, causing `if (!todo)` to throw `AppError("NOT_FOUND")`. The request path in `src/server/handlers/todo-handlers.ts` also validates the ID as a UUID and obtains the authenticated user through `useLoggedInAppSession`. The ownership predicate remains intact, so another user's todo cannot be deleted and now also cannot produce a false success response. `src/server/services/todo-service.server.test.ts` covers both nonexistent and cross-user IDs and expects `NOT_FOUND`, while confirming the cross-user row remains present. This correction was introduced by commit `a041f94337e958247fb48f6d2ab0ed41cb6dc446` (`Harden session and profile data handling`) and remains in the current HEAD.
